name: dsh-better-input
description: BetterInput是一套输入增强套件：语音识别、提示词优化、输入更多文件类型，各类文件转Md，交互体验优化等——把每一种喂给智能体的输入都变得更好。BetterInput is an input-enhancement suite — voice recognition, prompt optimization, more file types, everything-to-Markdown conversion, and UX refinements — making every input you feed an agent better.
